name: messaging-send-condition-accepted
description: firebase-admin/messaging send() with a condition target of the form "'a' in topics && 'b' in topics": FCM accepts and returns projects/<projectId>/messages/<numeric id>, the same resource-name shape as a direct topic send, with no subscribers required. dryRun=true returns the same shape. Cited by messaging-admin#4, messaging-admin#14 (surface climbing under CDD; cited, not yet replayed).
